narrative.overview: Photography leads; the interface gives it space. The original Sunlight and Theinhardt pairing is retained, with dramatic serif display type and restrained functional text. A warm paper ground alternates with near-black photographic scenes.
keyCharacteristics: Monumental product imagery and asymmetric editorial composition.
High-contrast serif type with occasional italic emphasis.
Flat controls, fine rules and generous separation.
One authored scroll scene, supported by GSAP masked typography, image reveals and Lenis continuity.

rules.name: The Material Colour Rule
rules.body: Let product photographs supply the expressive colour; keep navigation and reading surfaces quiet.

rules.name: The Complete Phrase Rule
rules.body: Headlines must remain fully visible at every viewport; adjust their scale or line breaks before accepting clipping or a stranded article.

rules.name: The Quiet Motion Rule
rules.body: Lenis and ScrollTrigger share the GSAP ticker. Keep touch scrolling native, use one authored sticky scene, and pause smoothing while overlays are open. System and manual reduced-motion settings remove choreography and pinning.

dos: Do retain the local Sunlight and Theinhardt font files.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and support reduced motion.
donts: Don’t invent heritage, product specifications, prices or external purchase URLs.
